description: Tricks: prepare (unsigned) one step of a SQUAD raid on a rival crew (3 to 5 wallets, each puts up the same stake; part of each stake is lost on a miss). action: open (you lead; crewId + stakeZeni, 1,000 to 100,000), join (raidId; approves the stake), cancel (raidId; leader any time, anyone after a game day; everyone is refunded), launch (raidId; leader, 3+ in the squad; the result is a drand round about 30 s later), settle (raidId; anyone, after the round). A Safehouse, a cooldown or a Burner Phone can stop it.

action.description: open, join, cancel, launch or settle.

crewId.description: For open: the rival crew id.

raidId.description: For join, cancel, launch, settle: from open / get_tricks_state.

stakeZeni.description: For open: the stake each wallet puts up, in ZENI, e.g. "5000".

wallet.description: Your own 0x wallet address. Nothing is sent from it; it is used to read your balance and allowance and to simulate.

name: prepare_crew_raid
